Consider the following statements :
I. The Kailasanatha temple of Kanchi is the earliest Pallava temple hewn from solid rock.
II. The Vaikuntha Perumal temple at Kanchi is a rare Pallava temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.subject: History
flags: SUBTOPIC FORCED: these are HINDU (Shaiva and Vaishnava) Pallava temples, and the only architecture subtopic in the catalog is 'Buddhism, Jainism and Religious Architecture'. Its 'Religious Architecture' half is the fit. The Pallavas also straddle Ancient / Early Medieval and the catalog's Medieval chapter names only Chola, Rajput, Ahom and Sikh, so Ancient India is the closer chapter.
